title: Personal Blog Platform
description: Build a fully functional blog with posts, comments, and user authentication.
problemStatement:
## Your Mission

Create a complete blog application where users can register, log in, write posts, and comment on posts. The blog should have:

- A home page listing all posts (ordered by date).
- Post detail page showing full content and comments.
- Ability for logged‑in users to create, edit, and delete their own posts.
- Ability for logged‑in users to comment on any post.
- Admin interface to manage users, posts, and comments.
- Basic styling with CSS (or you can use a framework like Bootstrap).

This project synthesizes everything from Chapters 1–7: models, views, templates, forms, authentication, and the admin.

**Requirements:**
- Use Django's built‑in User model for authentication.
- Post model: title, content, author (ForeignKey), created_at, updated_at.
- Comment model: post (ForeignKey), author (ForeignKey to User), content, created_at.
- URL patterns that are meaningful (e.g., /posts/, /posts/<id>/).
- Use class‑based views for at least one part (e.g., ListView for posts).
- Use `@login_required` decorator or mixins to protect creation/editing views.
- Ensure only the author can edit/delete their own posts.
- Provide a simple CSS file to style the pages.

**Optional Enhancements:**
- Add a search form to find posts by title.
- Add pagination to the post list.
- Implement a WYSIWYG editor for post content.
- Add a profile page for users.
requirements: Implement user registration and login/logout using Django's authentication system.
Create Post and Comment models with appropriate fields and relationships.
Build views and templates for listing posts, showing single posts, creating/editing posts, and adding comments.
Protect post creation/editing/deletion with login and author checks.
Style the application with CSS (either custom or framework).
Ensure the admin interface is customized to show relevant fields and filters.
Write at least 3 tests for models or views.
hints: Start by creating a new app named 'blog'.
Use `@login_required` for create/edit views, and check `post.author == request.user` in edit/delete views.
For comments, you can use a `CreateView` with a custom `form_valid` that sets the comment's author and post.
Remember to run `collectstatic` to gather your CSS files.
Use `get_absolute_url()` in models to define canonical URLs.
For the comment form, you can pass the post id via URL and set it in the view.
expectedOutput: A fully functional blog where users can register, log in, create posts, and comment. All pages should be styled and the admin should be usable.
